handbookNote: Batch-2 depth expansion for Maine notary public (4 M.R.S. Title 4, Chapter 39 -- Revised Uniform Law on Notarial Acts -- and Secretary of State Rules, C.M.R. Chapter 700), grounded in the same primary-source compilation as batch 1 (temp/handbooks/me/notary.txt): full statute text, full C.M.R. Ch. 700 rule text, the Secretary of State's Notary Public Course of Study, and the official application form (used only for procedural/practical grounding, never for the State's own literal 15-item open-book exam wording). Maine's real notary exam is unusually short (15 embedded, open-book questions plus an 8-term matching exercise), so this batch deliberately goes deeper than the exam itself into topics batch 1 did not yet cover in depth: technology-provider regulation for electronic and remote notarization (C.M.R. Ch. 700 Sections 5-6), the complaint/investigation/discipline apparatus (Section 4), application/renewal procedural mechanics (Sections 2-3), journal entry-content mechanics (4 M.R.S. Section 1920(3), (5)-(7)), jurisdiction/certified-copy/protest restrictions (Course of Study; C.M.R. Ch. 700 Sections 8-9), practical ethics content from the Course of Study, scenario-based conflict-of-interest and identification fact patterns applying 4 M.R.S. Section 1904/1907, and statutory-construction cross-references (4 M.R.S. Sections 1902, 1927-1932) -- price matches this project's established Notary tier ($9.99), not a placeholder
